scope: Cloud preparation of the fixed CPU layout comparison; no timing samples, GPU execution, benchmark workflow or second heavy build.
decision: The pinned CPU fixture has a plausible build path in this environment without GTK development packages. Full locked dependency acquisition and the actual release build remain unverified.

build_conditions.allocation_probe: Separate executable using the existing allocation-metrics feature; not yet built.
build_conditions.wrapper_policy: The existing build.py clears RUSTC_WRAPPER and RUSTC_WORKSPACE_WRAPPER for its own command.

dependency_scope.gpui_core_platform_split: The fixed harness depends on gpui core, not gpui_linux, gpui_platform or gpui_wgpu.
dependency_scope.optional_capture_dependency: Cargo.lock contains zed-scap and x11. The GPUI x11 feature uses scap?/x11, so it does not itself activate the optional screen-capture dependency. Cargo still requests its pinned source while resolving the full lock.

source_preparation.method: Shallow immutable Git revisions plus a sparse GPUI checkout; no native target cache copied.

upstream_tree_selected_payload.note: Static Git tree sum for the selected source directories and root manifest/instruction/license files; not a memory measurement.

source_preparation.patch_reproducibility: The source files were identical. A repository-local diff.mnemonicPrefix=true reproduces the previously recorded i/ and w/ diff labels and exact patch bytes; compiler settings and algorithms are unchanged.

checks.name: Pinned zgpui source and manifest versus baseline
checks.method: git diff baseline -- Cargo.toml src; no differences

checks.name: Full offline Linux dependency metadata
checks.reason: The pinned Git dependency is not in the cloud Cargo cache; --offline prevents checkout. This is not a compiler failure or a proven system-library blocker.

next_steps_after_coordinator_releases_th: Fetch the exact locked Linux dependency sources with the existing Rust toolchain; retain Cargo.lock unchanged and resolve any actual platform requirement without disabling GPUI features.
Run the existing timing-only release build at jobs=1 and nice=19 in a task-private disk-backed target. Record actual resource monitoring; do not claim native systemd limits apply in cloud.

Build the separate allocation probe under the same source/profile conditions.

Before transferring or measuring, hash the executables and record the actual host/toolchain. Any native result requires execution on the native host; cloud build or correctness alone is not a native performance result.
